attachments.title: <https://github.com/vim/vim/issues/8759|#8759 line2byte() returns an incorrect value.>
attachments.text:
*Describe the bug*  
If the text property is set to before line 400, the result of line2byte() after line 400 will be an incorrect value.

*To Reproduce*

sample.vim

```
:call setline(1,range(500))
:echom “before” line2byte(401)
:call prop_type_add('vim-test',{})
:call prop_add(2,1,{‘type’: ‘vim-test’})
:echom “after” line2byte(401)
```

1. `vim -u NONE`
2. `:source sample.vim`

the script result

```
before 1491
after 1511

```

*Expected behavior*

`:echom “before” line2byte(401)` and `:echom “after” line2byte(401)` show same line2byte value.

*Environment (please complete the following information):*

• Vim version [8.2.3325]
• OS: macOS 10.15.7
• Terminal: Alacritty

## line2byte() returns an incorrect value.
**Describe the bug**
If the text property is set to before line 400, the result of line2byte() after line 400 will be an incorrect value.

**To Reproduce**

sample.vim
```vim
:call setline(1,range(500))
:echom “before” line2byte(401)
:call prop_type_add(‘vim-test’,{‘bufnr’:1})
:call prop_add(2,1,{‘type’: ‘vim-test’})
:echom “after” line2byte(401)
```

1. `vim  -u NONE`
2. `:source sample.vim`

the script result
```
before 1491
after 1511
```
**Expected behavior**

`:echom “before” line2byte(401)` and `:echom “after” line2byte(401)` show same value.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Vim version [8.2.3325]
 - OS: macOS 10.15.7
 - Terminal: Alacritty
1200 行目から今度はサイズが縮むと言う珍現象を観測…
よさそう。あ、あと `'bufnr': 1` と `'id': 2` はなくても再現しました

sample.vim
```:call setline(1,range(500))
:echom "before" line2byte(401)
:call prop_type_add('vim-test',{'bufnr':1})
:call prop_add(2,1,{'bufnr': 1, 'id': 2, 'type': 'vim-test'})
:echom "after" line2byte(401)```
```$vim -u NONE
:source sample.vim```
こんな感じですかね
一応、Issue 化する場合は Vim を起動するところからの手順が必要ですね(今は一旦メモと言う感じで)。バッファの内容は 400 行以上あればどうでもよさそうなので `:call setline(1, range(500))` とかで作っちゃうとよさそう
